note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: # owner signs in once, off camera: pac auth create --deviceCode (labadmin, interactive)

Read-Host 'Owner: TEST and PROD environments (MG Lab TEST / MG Lab PROD) created; service principals for DEV, TEST and PROD made with pac admin create-service-principal (secrets in a password manager, never on screen); Dataverse and Outlook connections in TEST and PROD shared with the application users. Press Enter'

Read-Host 'Owner: Azure DevOps (organization devladlog): Power Platform Build Tools installed, private project with repo, src contents pushed to main, service connections mglab-dev/test/prod, variable groups equipmentdesk-test/prod, environments with the PROD approval, build service repository permissions, pipelines export-solution-to-git and build-and-release created. Press Enter'
Read-Host 'Owner: DEV has the environment variable Reminder domain (default contoso.com, current value removed from the solution) and SendLoanReminder uses it. Press Enter'

screens.name: solution-dev
steps: Select the DEV environment: Solutions > Equipment Desk (unmanaged)
Components: the environment variable Reminder domain (default contoso.com, current value empty), the two connection references, SendLoanReminder
Open SendLoanReminder: the Problem expression uses the variable
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: export-run
steps: Open the private lab project > Pipelines > export-solution-to-git: run it, then open the finished run
Show the steps and the mirror/lint output
Repos > Branches > export/<run> > Create a pull request: show the diff
Complete the pull request into main
mask: Azure DevOps organization and project names
any application id or secret (none may be visible)

screens.name: release-run
steps: Pipelines > build-and-release > Run pipeline with 'Upgrade an already installed solution' off
Show Build green, Test green, Prod waiting for approval
Open the Build log: the Checker step; artifact 'drop' with both zips
Approve Prod with the comment 'TEST checked' and show it turn green
mask: Azure DevOps organization and project names

screens.name: prod-managed
steps: Switch to the PROD environment: Solutions > Equipment Desk shows Managed with version 1.0.<build>.<rev>
Open the environment variable Reminder domain: current value contoso.com
Switch to TEST: current value test.contoso.com
In PROD the flow SendLoanReminder is On
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
environment names (MG Lab TEST/PROD), connection names and ids

teardown: Write-Host 'Reminder: delete the Azure DevOps project; delete the three app registrations and the application users; delete the TEST and PROD environments; clear the password-manager entries. DEV keeps the solution; do not re-run episode 6 FlowDeploy (it puts the hard-coded domain back).'
